texts.facts: 1. This a revision petition u/s 397 Cr.P.C. against order dated 12.12.2018 passed passed by Ld. MM-06, South East, Saket in CC No. 12534/2018 titled "Virender Grover Vs. Mainframe Energy Solutions Pvt. Ltd. & Ors." whereby the revisionist was summoned to face trial for the commission of an offence punishable u/s 138 Negotiable Instruments Act (hereinafter referred to NI Act). The said complaint was filed by the respondent herein. The present revision petition is accompanied by an application u/s 5 of Limitation Act. Brief Facts Devraj Singh vs Virender Grover on 3 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41857373/ 1 2. Briefly stated, the case put forth by the respondent against the revisionist and others (including a company namely M/s. Main Frame Energy Solution Pvt. Ltd.) in the said complaint is that the cheque(s) issued by the said company in his favour - bearing the signatures of one Jitendra Narayan - was dishonoured upon presentation. The said company and its Directors were served a legal notice demanding the payment due under the said cheque(s), but no response was received. Consequently, the above mentioned complaint was filed against the said company as well as its three Directors including the revisionist. Grounds of Revision 3. The sole ground cited by the revisionist against the impugned order dated 12.12.2018 is that the respondent has failed to make necessary averments in the said complaint u/s 141 of Negotiable Instruments Act against the revisionist. As such, it is argued that the impugned order is liable to be [LEAKAGE_MASK]. Regarding the delay in filing of revision petition, it is submitted that an application for discharge from the case was filed on Crl. Rev. No. 152/2024 Devraj Singh Vs. Virender Grover 2/13 behalf of the revisionist on the same grounds before the Ld. Trial Court on the very first date of appearance (i.e. on 25.04.2019). But the said application remained pending till 25.01.2024, when the same was withdrawn by the revisionist with liberty to approach the appropriate forum. It is further submitted that the delay in filing the present revision petition may be condoned in view of the settled law on the point of summoning of 'Directors' of a company u/s 138 NI Act r/w Section 141 NI Act and also the 'liberty' granted by the Ld. Trial Court at the time of disposal of discharge application moved by the revisionist. 4. It is prayed that the order dated 12.12.2018 may be [LEAKAGE_MASK]. Counsel for respondent has submitted that the matter may be disposed of as per law.

The complainant is supposed to know only gener- ally as to who were in charge of the affairs of the company or firm, as the case may be.
